headline: Complaints jumped 29% in July, driven almost entirely by North-West delivery delays.
body: North-West complaints nearly tripled versus the recent average, while other regions stayed flat or improved [E1]. A warehouse dispatch and conveyor breakdown caused repeated late deliveries there, directly fueling customer complaints [E6]. Enterprise customers are already citing these SLA misses as a reason to consider leaving [E3].

actions.action: Notify affected customers and issue goodwill credits now
actions.expected_impact: Reduce complaint escalation and protect at-risk enterprise accounts
actions.monitoring: Track North-West complaint rate and SLA % weekly

what_could_change: Confirmation that warehouse WH-07 throughput has recovered would strengthen this conclusion.
caveats: This shows delays and complaints moved together, not proven direct causation.
